SAME_CANONICAL_WORLD_IDENTITY.basis: The constrained tablet path continues to render the canonical Audralia world canvas and canonical H-Earth geographic integration; the operation adds only a staged cloud pass on the existing primary context.

PLANETARY_TO_REGIONAL_TO_GROUND_CONTINUI.basis: The existing world/navigation authority is preserved; the tablet repair does not replace or fork the planetary/regional/ground world path.

CONTINUOUS_TERRAIN_AND_GEOGRAPHIC_SPACE.basis: Terrain, hydrology, shoreline and geographic integration sources are read-only dependencies and were not mutated by the candidate.

EMBODIED_LOCAL_GROUND_EXPERIENCE.basis: The candidate preserves the existing renderer, camera frame derivation, focus-Gratitude behavior and navigable world surface; cloud restoration is presentation-only.

DIRECT_LOOK_AND_TRAVEL_INTERACTION.basis: The single-context tablet runtime preserves one-finger orbit/look, two-finger travel/zoom, wheel zoom, keyboard travel and focus-Gratitude controls while rendering clouds from the same camera frame.

MINIMAL_INTERFACE_INTRUSION_OVER_WORLD.basis: No new dashboard, panel, canvas or UI surface is introduced; clouds render in the existing world canvas.

TERRAIN_COAST_ELEVATION_AND_HORIZON_READ.basis: The exact primary world is rendered before cloud activation and terrain/coast/elevation authority is unchanged.

NO_PARALLEL_OR_DUPLICATE_H_EARTH_PRODUCT.basis: The repair creates no alternate H-Earth product, renderer or canvas and uses one primary WebGL2 context.

NO_DASHBOARD_MAP_APP_OR_CARD_UI_SUBSTITU.basis: The repaired surface remains the interactive Audralia planetary world, not a dashboard, map app or card interface.

GLOBE_IS_HIGHER_ALTITUDE_EXPRESSION_OF_T.basis: No globe/world identity or navigation authority was changed; the repair only adds clouds after the same primary world frame is presented.

REGION_ENTRY_MUST_NOT_CREATE_A_VISUALLY_.basis: The same renderer and interaction grammar remain active across the constrained tablet path; cloud activation does not replace the world or its controls.
